name.bn: BME280 তাপমাত্রা, আর্দ্রতা ও বায়ুচাপ সেন্সর
name.en: BME280 temperature, humidity and pressure sensor

summary.bn: I2C দিয়ে তাপমাত্রা, আর্দ্রতা আর বায়ুচাপ পাঠায়। ৩.৩ ভোল্টে চলে।
summary.en: Sends temperature, humidity and air pressure over I2C. Runs on 3.3 V.

simplified: The chip is answered register by register as Bosch's datasheet gives them; the program runs Adafruit's own library (2.3.0) to read it. The chip's factory trimming values are example values, the same for every sensor in the lab; the lab writes the raw readings they turn back into the sliders' values.
It answers with the values on its sliders at once: no measuring time, noise, filter or self-heating, and its oversampling and standby settings are kept but change nothing.
It is the common four-pin module with no regulator, for 3.3 V: above 3.6 V the lab warns. Its I2C address is 0x76 or 0x77, as its SDO pad sets it; the lab sets it in the inspector.
Its SPI connection is not modelled: the lab has no SPI.
Its supply current and the module's 10 kΩ pull-ups are estimates.
